snippet.title: Circus Welt — How It Works | A cinematic mystery you play together
snippet.description:
Circus Welt is a cinematic mystery you play together: one screen for the story, a phone in every hand.

How it works:
• Gather your troupe — solo, as a couple or with friends
• Sign in
• Watch the story, question the characters in your own words, crack the mechanisms
• Same room or apart: everyone gets their own puzzle. Team up… or race to crack it first
• Stuck? Step-by-step hints. Pause anytime — your progress is saved

Plays in the browser on a phone, laptop or TV. Nothing to install. Episode One takes about 2 hours.

🎟 Get Episode One: https://circuswelt.itch.io/circus-welt
▶ Play in your browser: https://weltcircus.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch-2511&utm_content=trailer
✉ Press: press@weltcircus.com
🎥 Twitch: https://twitch.tv/circuswelt
